verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in AI palette (cmd+j on highlighted text) with prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items', plus open-ended and saved custom prompts. It also lets you 'chat' with notes narrowed by search filters (date, tags, backlinks, pinned), which scopes what the AI sees, and you can toggle between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet in preferences. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI data handling and privacy controls (e.g., what is sent to third-party models given the E2E encryption claims, or an opt-out), explicit drafting/generation documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI quality and grounding.
